title: AI 정보 지원과 발주 의사결정
assignment: Participant-level, 1:1, permuted blocks of four, concealed until after consent and comprehension
commonSupport: Same Korean documents, sales chart, arithmetic worksheet, manager replies, costs and order limits. AI arm additionally sees frozen-model parameter/evidence/forecast/order suggestions.
manager: Scripted information service, not another human participant
primaryOutcome: Participant mean of (expected order regret or hold cost + question cost), divided by the case's declared hold cost, over all eight assigned main tasks
analysis: Participant is the randomized unit. Report allocation, attrition, participant-mean arm contrast, block-adjusted OLS and block-preserving randomization test only when all assigned outcomes are observed. With missing tasks, report bounded ITT effects and a labeled completer comparison; do not silently discard withdrawals.
stopping: Stop enrollment at 128 randomized participants. Early close requires a recorded reason. No replacement based on performance and no effect display during enrollment.

powerPlanning.note: Normal approximation for a half-SD effect on participant averages; not based on measured human variance or a validated economic MDE. Smaller recruitment is an exploratory pilot.

exclusions: No consent, non-adult, or comprehension not completed: not randomized. Once randomized, record every assigned participant including incomplete/withdrawn cases for attrition and bounded effects. Technical failures are logged, never removed based on loss.
data: No names, email addresses, IP logs, or free-text personal data. Random participant codes, consent, prior inventory experience, quiz attempts, task responses and server timestamps. Invite-to-person contact list stays with the recruiter outside the application.
interpretation: Randomized laboratory assistance effect in generated tasks. Not evidence of real managerial work, corporate profit, or the behavior of professional managers unless recruited and separately justified.
preRegistration: This local specification is not an external preregistration or institutional approval. Freeze the local protocol before invitations; publish/register it before recruitment if claiming a preregistered confirmatory study.
